text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Clamp sleeve: 80 mm of 33.7 x 2.3 tube (bore 29.1 mm, a slip fit on

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the 28.6 mm steerer). Saw a 3 mm slot 50 mm up from its bottom at

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the back; weld two 13 x 6 x 30 mm lugs either side, drill 6.5 and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: tap one M6, for two M6 clamp bolts.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Column: 38 x 2 tube 441 mm long; it slides 30 mm over the sleeve's top

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and is welded all round; 3 mm cap plate on its top.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Stem: 53 mm of 30 x 2 tube, horizontal, welded to the column's back,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: its centre 20 mm below the column top.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bar clamp: 40 mm of 26.9 x 2.3 tube (bore 22.3), crosswise on the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: stem's end, slotted underneath with two M6 bolts like the sleeve.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the sleeve sits on the headset top cover and clamps the steerer;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the bar centre ends up 1230 mm above the ground.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: column and steerer in line within 1 mm over 400 mm.
